args.command: cd /bench/repo && grep -n "^export function use\|^export const use\|memoServiceClient\.\|^import" web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts | head -60

message.text:
q17.

**`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`**

The module is a TanStack Query layer holding the full memo CRUD surface — `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo` as mutations, plus `useMemos`, `useInfiniteMemos`, `useMemo`, `useMemoComments`, `useInfiniteMemoComments`, and `useLinkMetadata` as queries. Every one of them goes through the same client, imported at the top:

```5:5:web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts
import { memoServiceClient } from "@/connect";
```

That client is the generated `MemoService` Connect client created in `web/src/connect.ts` (line 197) from `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb`. The file also defines a `memoKeys` cache-key factory and helpers like `patchMemoInCollectionQueries` so mutations can patch cached list results in place rather than refetching.
